create_sequential_layer: create a Sequential layer that chains multiple sublayers together in order
build_named_group: build a NamedGroup layer that names an activation or sequence of layers for inspection
create_checked_sequential: create a CheckedSequential layer with input and output type annotations for shape checking
inline_anonymous_sequentials: inline anonymous Sequential instances into parent groups to flatten nested structures
test_is_sequential_or_named: test whether a tree node is a subclass of Sequential, CheckedSequential, or NamedGroup
